identity.name: Task Scanner  Automated Active Tasks Index Generator

meta.description: Create task_scanner.py to scan honeycombs/tasks/active/*.json and generate/update tasks/index.json with active tasks summary. Read-only, no modifications to source task files (Ahimsa).

requirements: Scan all JSON files in honeycombs/tasks/active/
Extract: task_id, name, status, priority, deadline, progress, tags
Generate tasks/index.json with summary and task list
Auto-detect task_id from git log if missing (report only, no fix)
Integrate with existing scanner framework (reuse honeycomb_scanner.py patterns)
next_actions: 1. Create task_scanner.py based on honeycomb_scanner.py structure
